source.title: Perseus - Chosen Champion
source.name: Perseus
source.description: A Warrior blessed by the God of Harvest, skilled with spear and shield.

skills.name: Divine Rend

description.raw: Perseus chooses a direction and marches 3 tiles forward with dazzling spearwork. Along the way, he deals 85% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage to adjacent enemies 11 times and continuously knocks them back in the direction of his march. At the end of the march, Perseus performs a mighty shield bash, dealing 280% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) damage to all enemies within 1 tiles and stunning them for 2s. Perseus stays unaffected while casting this skill.
active: Perseus chooses a direction and marches 3 tiles forward with dazzling spearwork.
Along the way, he deals 85% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage to adjacent enemies 11 times and continuously knocks them back in the direction of his march.
At the end of the march, Perseus performs a mighty shield bash, dealing 280% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) damage to all enemies within 1 tiles and stunning them for 2s.
Perseus stays unaffected while casting this skill.

text: Increases Perseus' damage during his march to 90% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) and his shield bash damage to 290% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based).
Increases Perseus' damage during his march to 95% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) and his shield bash damage to 300% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based).
Increases Perseus' damage during his march to 100% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) and his shield bash damage to 310% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based).
Increases Perseus' damage during his march to 105% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) and his shield bash damage to 320% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: Perseus marches continuously in one direction while swinging his spear.

skills.name: Spear-Shield Combo

description.raw: Perseus swings both his spear and shield in a circle to strike nearby enemies. With his spear, he deals 200% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage to adjacent enemies. With his shield, he deals 140% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage to adjacent enemies while gaining a shield value equal to 360% (ATK-based) of his ATK plus 80% of the damage dealt for 6s. While the shield lasts, his ATK SPD increases by 35.
active: Perseus swings both his spear and shield in a circle to strike nearby enemies.
With his spear, he deals 200% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage to adjacent enemies.
With his shield, he deals 140% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage to adjacent enemies while gaining a shield value equal to 360% (ATK-based) of his ATK plus 80% of the damage dealt for 6s.
While the shield lasts, his ATK SPD increases by 35.

text: Increases spear swing damage to 210% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) and shield swing damage to 150% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based).
Increases spear swing damage to 220% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) and shield swing damage to 160% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based).
Increases spear swing damage to 230% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) and shield swing damage to 170% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: Perseus swings his spear and shield, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

skills.name: Fertile Ground

description.raw: Before Perseus takes heavy damage, the ground within 1 tile around him turns fertile. Allies standing on this fertile ground have their ATK increased by 14.5% + 1.5% (SP-based) and Phys & Magic DEF increased by 19% + 2.5% (SP-based). When Perseus' HP drops below 40% of his initial HP for the first time, he draws power from the fertile ground, increasing his max HP permanently by 60% + 6% (SP-based) and healing for the same amount. Once this power is drawn the fertile ground withers away permanently.
active: Before Perseus takes heavy damage, the ground within 1 tile around him turns fertile.
Allies standing on this fertile ground have their ATK increased by 14.5% + 1.5% (SP-based) and Phys & Magic DEF increased by 19% + 2.5% (SP-based).

When Perseus' HP drops below 40% of his initial HP for the first time, he draws power from the fertile ground, increasing his max HP permanently by 60% + 6% (SP-based) and healing for the same amount.
Once this power is drawn the fertile ground withers away permanently.

text: Allies standing on the fertile ground now have their ATK increased by 15.5% + 1.5% (SP-based) and Phys & Magic DEF increased by 21% + 2.5% (SP-based).
Allies standing on the fertile ground now have their ATK increased by 16.5% + 1.5% (SP-based) and Phys & Magic DEF increased by 23% + 2.5% (SP-based).
Allies standing on the fertile ground now have their ATK increased by 17.5% + 1.5% (SP-based) and Phys & Magic DEF increased by 25% + 2.5% (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: Perseus grants buffs to allies standing on fertile ground.

skills.name: Hero Focus

description.raw: Increases his ATK by 9% in battle. Further increases his ATK by 6% when he has temporary stat buffs from allies.

Further increases his ATK by 6% when he has temporary stat buffs from allies.

Further increases his ATK by 8% when he has temporary stat buffs from allies.

skills.description_lite: Increases his ATK in battle. Further increases his ATK after receiving temporary stat buffs.

skills.name: Divine Grace

description.raw: Perseus is blessed by Bountiful Grace. When he gains a temporary stat buffs, its effect is increased by 20%. Each temporary stat buff from a different ally also increases his damage dealt by 15% and reduces his damage taken by 15%. This effect stacks up 4 times.
active: Perseus is blessed by Bountiful Grace.
When he gains a temporary stat buffs, its effect is increased by 20%.
Each temporary stat buff from a different ally also increases his damage dealt by 15% and reduces his damage taken by 15%.
This effect stacks up 4 times.

text: When Perseus gains a temporary stat buff, its effect is increased by 30%.
When Perseus has 2 temporary stat buffs from different allies, the damage he deals is converted to true damage, and he comes unaffected.
This effect lasts at least 6s each time it's triggered.
When Perseus gains a temporary stat buff, its effect is increased by 40%.

skills.description_lite: Perseus gains stronger effects from any temporary stat buffs he receives.
